Ushbu siyosat Davlat mulki obyektlaridan: This policy explains what information is processed during your visit to the Davijara.uz portal (hereinafter referred to as the Portal), which is managed by the Center for the use of state facilities (hereinafter referred to as the Center).
Portaldan foydalanish uchun roʻyxatdan o: Registration is not required to use the Portal. The publicly accessible section of the Portal does not contain forms requesting names, telephone numbers, passport details or other personal data.
Qidiruv va saralash shakllari faqat siz: Search and sorting forms include your selected criteria (region, district, area, price and auction date) only in the page URL. These criteria are not stored separately.
Portalda eʼlon qilinadigan savdo natijal: Personal data of auction winners and participants is not disclosed in the auction results published on the Portal.
Portal tashriflar sonini oʻz hisoblagich: The Portal tracks the number of visits using its own counter and does not set cookies for this purpose. IP addresses and browser types are not stored. Instead, a hash is calculated from this information using a one-way key that changes daily, and only a short portion of the hash is retained. It is impossible to reconstruct an IP address from this hash or link visits made on different days. Individual visit records are deleted after three days, and only the total daily visit count is retained.
Portalda Yandex.Metrika xizmati ham qoʻl: The Portal also uses Yandex Metrica. This service collects aggregated statistics on pages viewed, click maps and clicks on external links, and sets its own cookies in your browser. The session recording feature (Webvisor) is disabled. This data is processed in accordance with Yandex's Privacy Policy.
NEXT_LOCALE – tanlangan tilni (oʻzbek, r: NEXT_LOCALE – to remember your selected language (Uzbek, Russian or English);

rang sxemasi, yuqori kontrast, matn oʻlc: Colour scheme, high contrast, text size and text-to-speech settings are stored in your browser's local storage (localStorage) and are not sent to the server.
Cookie fayllarini brauzer sozlamalari or: You can delete or block cookies through your browser settings. The Portal's main features remain available without them.
“Matnni ovoz bilan oʻqish” funksiyasi yo: When you enable the "Text-to-Speech" feature, the text you select is sent to Microsoft Azure for conversion into speech. Only text from the Portal page is transmitted. The request is routed through the Portal's server, so your IP address is not shared with this service.
Xaritalar OpenStreetMap xizmatidan yukla: Maps are loaded from OpenStreetMap. When a map is displayed, your browser connects directly to its servers, which process your IP address in accordance with the OpenStreetMap Foundation's privacy policy.
Portaldagi e-auksion.uz, online-ijara.uz: Links to e-auksion.uz, online-ijara.uz, lex.uz and other external websites on the Portal direct you to those websites. Data processing on these websites is governed by their respective policies.

Shaxsga doir maʼlumotlar Oʻzbekiston Res: Personal data is processed in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan "On Personal Data".

Xodimlarga xizmat vazifalarini bajarish: When performing their official duties, employees are prohibited from receiving unlawful benefits, gifts or other material or non-material advantages, allowing situations that give rise to conflicts of interest, or using their official positions for personal gain or for the benefit of third parties.
